questionText: Is 80-100 pips a target-selection rule, or a description of past averages?
reason: Stated as 'an average of about 80 to 90 to even 100 pips'. No instrument, timeframe or method for choosing a target on a specific trade. It is nonetheless the FIRST target-shaped statement in five Alex G sources. Note also that it is expressed in PIPS - relevant to PROPOSAL-001, since MOGO is pip-native and TJR trades US indices.
